title: The conjugacy problem in cyclic extensions of one-ended hyperbolic groups
summary: Let $G$ be a torsion-free one-ended hyperbolic group and let $φ\in\operatorname{Aut} (G)$. We prove that the mapping torus, or suspension, $$ M:=G_φ=G\rtimes_φ\mathbb{Z} $$ has solvable conjugacy problem. This builds on the pioneering work of Préaux who solved the conjugacy problem for all (geometrisable) three-manifolds. We view $M$ as a generalisation of a fibred three-manifold. Our proof begins with the canonical JSJ tree of $G$, whose suspension gives a graph-of-groups decomposition of $ M $.
